formal: Bachelor's degree + 3 years investigations experience, OR 5 years investigations experience (2 in case management) without degree

recommended_certs.rationale: PCI と CHFI を組み合わせて、物理/論理双方の調査スキルを示すパターン。

minus.note: Investigator profession is narrow; cyber DFIR practitioners typically choose GCFA/GREM/CHFI.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 1, specialty: 2. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Accreditation and verified investigation experience support a credible investigator specialization; the narrow profession-specific scope and knowledge-only assessment do not map cleanly onto a general cyber progression.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation and verified investigation and case-management experience support ownership of investigations at professional level. The multiple-choice format and investigator-specific scope leave cyber DFIR execution unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: The record supports an accredited, experience-backed investigation and case-management credential. Its narrow investigator profession and lack of practical cyber-forensics assessment make specialty more informative than an offensive-career rank.
